_comment: Paste this into Amplify: App settings -> Rewrites and redirects -> Open text editor.
_why: public/.htaccess does nothing on Amplify - it is an Apache file. Without an equivalent rule here, a direct visit or refresh on a nested route such as /learning-programs/full-stack-development returns Amplify's 404 instead of index.html, because no file exists at that path. This is the single most common broken thing about an SPA on Amplify.
_order: Amplify applies rules top to bottom and stops at the first match, so the asset rule MUST come before the catch-all. Reversing them would serve index.html for your JS and CSS and the site would render blank.

_comment: Everything else is a client-side route: hand back the app shell.
